name: Brr Brr Patapim
blurb: An AI-generated tree-monkey with giant feet whose hat is "full of Slim", viral in 2025
aka: il mio cappello è pieno di Slim
title: Brr Brr Patapim Meme: Meaning, Origin & Trend
description: Brr Brr Patapim is an AI-generated tree-monkey creature with huge feet, first posted on TikTok in February 2025 and a fixture of the Italian brainrot trend.
h1: What is the Brr Brr Patapim meme?
answer: Brr Brr Patapim is an Italian brainrot character: an AI-generated creature that is half forest tree, half monkey, with oversized human-like feet. TikToker @ofuscabreno posted the first video on 17 February 2025, with an Italian AI voice saying "Brr brr patapim, il mio cappello è pieno di Slim!" ("my hat is full of Slim"). It took off in late March 2025, especially in battle videos against Tung Tung Tung Sahur.

body: Patapim looks like a piece of forest tree with a monkey's face, standing on two very large feet. The narration, which grew into a longer Italian copypasta, tells a story: Patapim finds a golden hat with a blue frog named Slim inside, which is why his hat is "full of Slim".

body.note: The character is an AI-generated image (later AI-animated) with a synthetic Italian voice.

head: Date
Event
rows: @ofuscabreno posts the original AI image and voiceover on TikTok.
The creator posts a follow-up with a new image and flame effects.
Another user animates Patapim with an AI video generator, and AI-animated versions spread.
Clips move to YouTube in mid-March; late March sees the character's biggest surge.
A powerscaling video pitting Patapim against Tung Tung Tung Sahur gets almost half a million likes in two days.

ul: Quoting "il mio cappello è pieno di Slim" or just "brr brr patapim" as a nonsense catchphrase.
"Who would win" videos: Patapim versus Tung Tung Tung Sahur is one of the most repeated match-ups.
Fan lore with Slim the frog, and drawings that exaggerate his giant feet.
Tier lists ranking him among Tralalero Tralala, Bombardiro Crocodilo and the rest.

body: Patapim peaked with the rest of Italian brainrot in spring 2025. He remains part of the standard cast in games, cards and ranking videos, but is usually seen as a supporting character next to Tung Tung Tung Sahur.

faq.q: What does "il mio cappello è pieno di Slim" mean?
faq.a: Italian for "my hat is full of Slim". In the meme's story, Slim is a blue frog living in Patapim's hat.

faq.q: What animal is Brr Brr Patapim?
faq.a: A made-up hybrid: a forest tree mixed with a monkey, with huge feet. It is AI-generated.
